title: LNMU UG 2nd Merit List 2026 – Out
vacancyDetails: Second merit list for undergraduate admissions session 2026-30 across LNMU colleges and subjects
qualification: Intermediate / 10+2 pass with required subject combination
ageLimit: As per LNMU UG admission guidelines
applicationFee: Admission fee as applicable at college
selectionProcess: Online Application → Merit Lists → College Admission
documentsRequired: Merit list copy, Class 10 & 12 mark sheets, CLC, caste certificate, photo ID, photos
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.lnmu.ac.in
2. Open UG Merit List Portal / 2nd Merit List PDF
3. Download faculty/subject wise list
4. If selected, take admission between 20–24 July 2026 (as notified)
5. Watch for 3rd merit list if seats remain
shortDescription: LNMU UG 2nd Merit List 2026 released on 18 July 2026 for session 2026-30. Admission window for selected candidates typically 20–24 July 2026.
content:
Lalit Narayan Mithila University (LNMU) has released the 2nd Merit List for UG admission session 2026–30 on 18 July 2026.

Candidates selected in the second list should complete admission at the allotted college within the notified dates. If seats remain vacant, a 3rd merit list may be published.

Portal / notices: lnmu.ac.in.
